name: Device frames
summary: A browser window, a laptop and a phone drawn in CSS around a screenshot or live UI.
description:
Use device frames in heroes and feature sections to show the product in context. They hold any element, so the screen can be a screenshot or real Vectra markup.

Put the content in .v-device-screen; it fills the screen at the frame's aspect ratio. Set --v-device-ratio for another ratio and --v-device-width for the phone's width.

classes.name: v-device-browser
classes.description: A browser window with a title bar. Default ratio 16 / 10.

classes.name: v-device-laptop
classes.description: A laptop: the screen in a bezel on a base. Default ratio 16 / 10.

classes.name: v-device-phone
classes.description: A phone with a camera island. Default ratio 9 / 19.5 and width 18rem.

classes.name: v-device-bar
classes.description: The browser's title bar with three dots.

classes.name: v-device-url
classes.description: The address in the title bar.

classes.name: v-device-screen
classes.description: The screen. An or

a11y: The frame is decoration; the content carries the meaning, so give a screenshot real alt text.
Live markup inside a frame is real, focusable UI. If it is only a picture of the product, add inert to the screen.
